**with great joy, we invite you to celebrate the marriage of**

**Eleanor Grace Whitfield**
&
**James Alexander Hartley**

on Saturday, the twelfth of September, two thousand twenty-six
at half past three in the afternoon

The ceremony will be held at
The Old Chapel of Saint Bartholomew
124 Meadow Lane, Cotswold, Gloucestershire

A reception and dinner will follow at
The Manor House Gardens
where we will gather to share in the joy of the day

Dress code: Formal

We would be honored by your presence as we begin this new chapter together. Kindly respond by the first of August.

With love and warmest regards,

**Mr. and Mrs. Thomas Whitfield**
and
**Mr. and Mrs. Robert Hartley**
